race.comment: BROADWAY LANE (5) appeals as the one to beat after returning with a sound third at this track, where he led deep into the straight and was still fighting at the 100m. His overall record at this venue and four wins at the distance give him a reliable base, and the 2kg claim helps him second-up. RUSSIAN BOBSHARK (1) is the immediate danger after missing by a long neck in CL1 company here last start, with that effort rating strongly for a BM56 despite his modest win strike. CHAMPAGNE EFFORT (9) has to rebound from a plain ninth over 1210m on soft ground, but her beaten-a-nose second at this venue start prior keeps her right in the race. CATALINA BLUE (10) should be at her peak now and the inside barrier can see her right in the finish. GO ASK ALICE (3) has to be included on her recent form and looks to get every chance from the draw.
